title: Customer scenario player: deterministic on-prem/VPC load synthesizer for reproducible perf runs
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a deterministic "customer scenario player" that can run reproducible performance and load tests inside customer-like Private/VPC/on-prem environments. This harness will be used to validate tokens/sec, p95 latency, and throughput regressions when we onboard new kernels, runtime changes, or model quantization profiles. The goal is a single run artifact that operators and SREs can re-run in a target environment and get byte-for-byte comparable telemetry for regression detection.
background: We already have several replay/baseline runners but they diverge in semantics and are fragile across network topologies and KV cache states. This ticket unifies an opinionated runner that: (1) captures environment snapshot + request sequences, (2) replays deterministically with configurable randomness seeds, (3) warms KV cache and caches prefixes consistently, (4) collects standardized metrics (tokens/sec, p95, p50, p99, errors/sec, cpu/gpu utilization) and (5) performs an automated regression analysis against a golden baseline.
design_decisions: Deterministic seeding: every synthetic modifier (sampling, jitter, noise) must be driven by a 128-bit run seed so replays are deterministic.
KV cache warmup phase: separate warmup-only phase to stabilize KV cache and measure cold->warm delta.
Metric collection: expose Prometheus metrics and export a standardized JSON summary (tokens_sec, p95_ms, success_rate).
No direct customer PII: runs must sanitize request payloads before storing artifacts; sensitive fields replaced with placeholders using a scrubber library.
Binary artifacts: store captured scenario and env snapshot as versioned artifacts in S3-compatible bucket with content-addressed names to enable exact re-run.
acceptance_criteria: CLI: env-player run --snapshot <id> --seed <hex> executes end-to-end in target VPC and emits summary.json

Determinism: two runs with identical snapshot and seed produce identical token counts and key percentile latencies within measurement noise bounds (<2% for tokens/sec, <5ms for p95 on identical hardware).
Regression detection: pipeline computes relative change vs baseline and flags regressions when tokens/sec drops >7% or p95 increases >12% with p < 0.05 (Welch test).
Telemetry: Prometheus scrape targets and Grafana dashboard template included; dashboards show tokens/sec time series, p95 heatmap, and per-route error breakdown.
CI gating: a GitHub Action that runs a lightweight smoke scenario and posts a perf report comment on PRs touching runtime or kernels.
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (spike, 3 days): prototype deterministic seeder and artifacts format; validate local reproducibility.
Phase 2 (2 weeks): implement env-player CLI, KV warmup orchestration, Prometheus exporter, and artifact uploader.
Phase 3 (1 week): integrate statistical regression analysis, baseline storage, and Slack/CI alerts.
Phase 4 (1 week): on-prem deployment docs, runbook, and example customer snapshot for Private customers.
runbook_outline: Start: env-player validate --snapshot <id> to check system prerequisites (network, creds, quotas).
Post-run: env-player summarize /tmp/run-<id>/summary.json and upload to artifacts bucket if pass. If regression detected, open ENG ticket and notify #perf-alerts with link.
Troubleshoot: attach kernel logs from /var/log/redwood/runtime and /metrics/prometheus for incident triage.
instrumentation: Tracing: add a trace span for "player.request" with tags (route, model, seq_len, seed).
Artifacts: summary.json with keys: "tokens_sec", "p95_ms", "p50_ms", "p99_ms", "errors_rate", "seed", "snapshot_id" (values are numbers/strings in JSON artifact).
security_and_privacy: All stored artifacts must be encrypted with KMS; use customer-managed key when available.
Scrub PII: use redact pipeline to remove email/phone/account ids before saving request logs.
Network constraints: runner will use short-lived credentials and VPC endpoints for artifact upload; do not open public egress except for metrics ingest gateways.
notes_and_updates: 2026-03-10 - Ava Chen: Kickoff meeting held with SRE and Runtime. Decided on deterministic-seed approach and artifact format (CAR-like tar + manifest.json). Action: spike to validate seed stability.
2026-03-11 - Marcus Patel: Prototype seeder implemented (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2543). Local runs show tokens/sec variance ~0.8% across 10 repeats on devbox (good).

2026-03-12 - SRE (Dana Ortiz): Confirmed Prometheus labels for multi-tenant runs. Suggestion: add "run_id" and "snapshot_hash" labels, but avoid high-cardinality label explosion; will instead include run metadata in summary artifact.
risks: High variance across different customer network topologies could mask regressions; mitigation: include topology fingerprinting and run hardware-matched baselines.
Storing sanitized artifacts might still retain structured identifiers; mitigation: enhance scrubber and review sample artifacts with security team before first customer use.
CI cost: running full scenarios in CI is expensive; mitigation: lightweight smoke scenario for PRs and heavy runs scheduled nightly on dedicated infra.
next_steps: Finish Phase 1 spike and merge prototype seeder (PR feedback addressed).
Implement Prometheus exporter and example Grafana dashboard (owner: Dana Ortiz).
Schedule first Private env run with Solutions Engineering for ACME Corp snapshot (target: 2026-03-25).
